༄༅/ /slob ma dbang bskur bar byed pa'i tshul bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /slob ma dbang bskur bar byed pa'i tshul bzhugs/

slob ma dbang bskur bar byed par 'dod na/ nang par dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa byed rgyu'i deng gi nyin par te/ dgongs kha'i dus su slob ma rnams/ dkyil 'khor khang par 'tshog na dkyil 'khor la yol ba 'thug po btang ste bsgribs/ dkyil 'khor ma bshams pa'i sngon du yin na yang*/ rdul tshon bum pa sogs mi mthong ba'i phyir sgrib pa legs/ dkyil chog rdo rje las rim ltar na spyi dang mthun yang*/ phur pa'i chos skor gyi rtsa ba'i gzhung rnams kyi bzhed dgongs min pas/ sta gon rnam bzhi'i rim pa sogs gsar ma dang sbyar ba dgos pa'i nges pa med pas/ slob ma sta gon ji ltar skabs su bab pa la bya/ de yang slob ma rnams gu gul gyis bdug khrus byas/ gral la 'khod/ me tog bkye bsdu bya/ bla mas chos bshad byas nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bcug / skye rga na dang 'chi ba yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs byed las/ / 'don par mdzad pa khyod 'ba' zhig /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ / zhes pa nas/ mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum rjes zlos kyi gsol ba btab/ bu tshur gsang ba'i cho ga ni/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ khyod ni gsang ba'i snod yin te/ /dam tshig dam pa bstan par bya/ /byang chub sems kyang bskyed par bya/ /'khor ba dag las bskyab par bya/ /dkyil 'khor chen por bzhug par bya/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang bskur ro/ /da ni dad pa bskyed par bgyi/ zhes pa tsam mam spro na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*/ zhes pa'ang brjod de spro ba bskyed/ bdag gi sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ /bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /ma lus de dag bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs la bdag ni yid rang ngo*/ /sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i thabs kyi mchog

/de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sems can ma lus srid par lhung*/ /'gro ba rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /bdag gi de ring nyid du ni/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor bcas pa/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ / zhes pa nas/ mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ / tshul khrims kyis ni bslab pa dang*/ nas/ so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ / sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bsgrubs nas ni/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba rnams/ /byang chub gnas su sgrol bar shog rgyun gshags dang sdom bzung 'di/ rtsa ba lugs kyi dbang bskur la byed la mna' snam pa'i lugs dang kyi lugs sogs la mi byed do/ /dngos su maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa zhig bshams/ khyed rang rnams kyi mos pa la/ maṇ+ḍal 'di nyid gzhal med khang du mos/ /tshom bu lnga po gdod nas grub pa'i rgyal ba rigs lngar gyur/ puṣ+pe sogs mchod pa lnga phul/ oṃ bi shud+dhe sarba hi na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces slob ma bsangs/ yungs kar gtor la sum+bha bzlas pas bgegs bskrad/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus kyi rdo rje sems dpa' las rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis pa chad nas khyed rang rnams la thim/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur/ gnas gsum du bdud rtsi'i thig le byas la/ oṃ tsakra swā hā oṃ/ āḥpad+ma swā hā hrīḥ hūṃ badz+ra swā hā hūṃ/ zhes brjod la/ sku gsung thugs su sbyor ba yi/ /lus ngag yid gsum srung ba dang*/ / rnam thar gsum la 'god pa'i phyir/ /byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas mdzod cig dpung skud bcing pa'ang spyi dang 'dra ste/ hūṃ zhes drag tu bzla ba dang*/ snying po 'bru bcu drug pas bsrung ba bya/ rdo rje srung ba'i don du ni/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis btab// lus kyi nyes pa bsal ba dang*/ /srung dang sta gon gnas par mdzod/

ces brjod/ so shing*/ oṃ badz+ra dan da sam+ba ra tik+ṣa ṇa swā hā/ zhes pas byin gyis rlabs shing slob mar gtad/ /ngag gi nyes pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /dur khrod so shing dam pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor steng du rab tu dor/ /dbang gi lha rnams bstan du gsol/ zhes brjod nas 'dor du gzhug/khyor chu sbyin pa spyi dang 'dra/ /zab mo'i chos bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ yod med dag las rnam par 'das/ /nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med/ /rab tu rtog med gnas med pa/ /spros pa thams cad spangs pa yin/ zhes brjod cing de'i don bsam du gzhug/'di ni yid dag par byed pa ste/ spro na de'i rjes su/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag ces sogs spro ba bskyed pa'ang 'grub na legs/ de rjes yi ge 'bru gsum gyis bsngags pa'i rtswa'i sngas dang gdan gtad/ bu kye sang nas dkyil 'khor mchog / ces sogs nyal bar gdams shing rmi lam brtag pa spyi dang mthun te slob ma sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /nang par dngos gzhi'i skabs su/ bdag 'jug dang slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni/ lhag gtor gyis byed kyang legs pa'i skabs zhig yod mod/ 'on kyang bzlas pa'i gzhug gi bstod pa song ba'i mtshams der/ dang por bdag 'jug len par spro na 'di ltar bya ste/ de la sdoms ni/ gsol btab dri lan lha la zhu/ /nang 'jug phyag 'tshal rgyun bshags bya/ /sdom bzung mig dar me tog gtad/ /dam bzhag ye shes dbab pa dang*/ /ltas brtag me tog 'bul ba dang*/ /mig dar bsal la me tog bcings/ /bltar bskul lha ngo de nyid bstan/ /gsol btab bgegs bskrad chu dbang dang*//dbu rgyan rdo dril ming phyag mtshan/ /slob dpon dbang la gsol gdab dang*/ /slob ma lhar bskyed rdo dril gtad/ /chu dbang bskur la brtan bzhugs bya/ /rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan chos dus gtod/ /bka' yi gnang ba rjes gnang yin/ /gsang ba'i dbang la gsol gdab dang*/ /dbang bskur dngos dang lung bstan no/

/ sher dbang gsol btab thog mar gdams/ /dri ba dri lan gdabs pa dang*/ / rig ma gtad de dbugs dbyung bya/ /bzhi pa la yang gsol btab dang*//bdud rtsi sbyin nas brjod bral bsgom/ /de rjes dam tshig brtan par bya/ de ltar sdoms blo yul du nges par byas nas/ /dang po gsol btab ni/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i grong khyer du/ /slob dpon gyi ni bdag gzhug gsol/ gnyis pa dri ba ni/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /'dod don gang yin khyod kyis smros/ gsum pa lan ni/ skal bzang bdag ni bde chen la'o/ / bdag ni gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rab tu 'jug par 'tshal lags so/ / bzhi pa lha la zhu ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyid/ lnga pa nang du 'jug pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li sogs dang ā khaṃ pī ra sogs/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi dus skabs 'dir yol ba bsal/ drug pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor bcas la/ /lus ngag yid gsum phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun bshags kyi sngon du/ sdom pa sgrags pa byed par spro na/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ zhes pa nas/ ci nus bgyi/ zhes pa'i bar spyi dang mthun pa byed par bshad kyang*/ bsdu na nges par dgos pa'ang min pas/ bdag gi sdig pa zhes pa nas/ gnas su sgrol bar shog gi bar slob ma sta gon gyi bar bzhin/ bdun pa rgyun bshags dang*/ brgyad pa sdom bzung lan gsum bya/ dgu pa mig dar ni/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ gis bcings/ bcu pa me tog kyang ā khaṃ bī ra hū ཾ gis bzung*/ /bcu gcig pa dam la bzhag pa ni/ rigs kyi bu khyod tshur nyon cig/

de ring bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /nang du khyod ni bzhugs pa yin/ /slob dpon lung bstan ngas kyang ni/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /ye shes khyod la bskyed par bya/ /rnal 'byor bu mchog khyod kyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dngos grub dam pa thob 'gyur na/ /dngos grub gzhan rnams lta ci smos/ /dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba'i/ drung du smra bar ma byed cig ces dang*/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /de ring khyod kyi snying la zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ zhes dang*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chus 'dis 'grub/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa a mṛ ta ha na ha na ḍa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ deng nas brtsams te thams cad du/ /rdo rje gzhon nu nga yin gyi/ /nga yis smras pa bu yis gyis/ /nga la brnyas par ma byed cig khyod kyis gal te brnyas na ni/ khyod ni sdug bsngal dang bcas te/ /tshe yi 'du byed btang nas ni/ /sems can dmyal ba chen por lhung*/ bcu gnyis pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ slob dpon chen po dgongs su gsol/ /sems can kun la phan bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i 'khor bcas rnams/ /de ring bdag la dbab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ rang gi snying gar hūṃ yig sngags kyi 'phreng ba dang bcas pa me 'od rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer ma mchis pa'i thugs ka nas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma lcags kyu thogs pa dpag tu med pa sprul zhing spros/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs/ snying ga'i sa bon sngags bcas la thim/ sdig sgrib dag

/sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ lus nang thams cad 'od kyis gang bar gyur/ 'bru bcu drug pa'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya a a a/ zhes lan brgya rtsa sogs brjod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra bcu gsum pa ltas brtag pa ni/ /las dang mthun pa'i nam mkha'i kha dog mthong*/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ nam mkha'i kha dog skabs 'dir 'bri/ bcu bzhi pa me tog bul ba ni/ oṃ dri zhim me tog dam pa 'di/ /dkyil 'khor dam par dbul bar bgyi/ oṃ pratīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ bco lnga pa mig dar bsal ba ni/ sngon gyi mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ khyod kyi mi shes rab rib bsal/ oṃ pra ba ra sha ya phaṭa/ bcu drug pa me tog bcings pas dbang bskur ba ni/ stobs dang ldan pa'i sems can khyod/ /me tog 'phreng bas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ me tog spyi bor bcings/ bcu bdun pa blta bar bskul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /shes rab rnam gsum rab tu skyed/ /khyod ni thugs kyi rigs su skye/ /bde bar gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'gyur/ /rigs drug sems can thams cad la/ /bu bzhin snying rje kun nas bskyed/ /gsang ba'i chos la dad par gyis/ bco brgyad pa lha ngo ni/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor grub pa ni/ nam mkha'i khams su zhes pa nas/ gdan rnams su gyur/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po he ru ka nas/ gnyis med 'khyud ces pa'i bar dang*/ khro bo bcu 'khor dang bcas par gyur pa nas/ dpag tu med pa dang bcas par grub par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar sa bon dang sngags rnams bor ba'i sgo nas lha ngo bo bstan/ skabs 'dir rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur zhes brjod/ bcu dgu pa de kho na nyid kyi bstan pa ni/

dkyil 'khor gru bzhir gyur pa ni/ /tshad med bzhi rnams dag pa'i rtags/ /sgo bzhi dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ /gsal bar dag pa'i rtags yin no/ /rta babs yang dag spong ba bzhi/ /rnam par dag pa'i rtags yin no/ /dra ba dra phyed 'phyang ba ni/ /nyon mongs nye nyon rnam dag pa'o/ /ka ba brgyad kyis dbus brgyan pa// 'phags lam brgyad po rnam dag rtags/ /rin chen pha gu la sogs rgyan/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'o/ /rdo rje'i rwa bas bskor ba ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dag pa'i rtags/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad rnam dag pa'o/ khro bo chen po bcu rnams ni/ /mi dge bcu rnams dag pa ste/ /de rnams kun gyi yon tan gyi/ /chos rnams rnam dag yum rnams so/ /stobs bcu rnam dag khro bo dang*/ /dbang bcu rnam dag yum rnams te/ /stong nyid rnam dag phyag brnyan la/ /tshangs gnas dag pa'i sgo srung so/ / de ltar na dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa ni/ dad pa'i sa tshogs kyis lam mo/ /nyi shu pa dbang dngos gzhi'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ slob dpon dam pa dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang bskur ba/ /sems can kun la phan gdags phyir/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang stsol cig lan gsum/ nyer gcig la bgegs bskrad pa ni/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ gu gul bdug /yungs kar gyis brabs/ /bden pa ngar dang bcas te bgegs skrod pa'i tshig brjod dgos la/ bdag 'jug gi skabs kī li bzlas shing rdo rje gsor ro/ nyer gnyis pa chu dbang ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa bi shud+dho3 haṃ/ bdag dang dbang rdzas stong pa'i ngang las/ pad nyi la gnas pa'i huṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ badz+ra he ru ka yab yum sku mdog mthing nag /rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas thams cad rdzogs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar huṃ/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhuṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba las ye shes bum pa'i chur gyur/ che ba'i yon tan kun rdzogs shing*/ /byang chub sems chus rab gang ba/ /rnam par dag pa'i bum pa 'dis/ de ring bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra abhi ṣits+tsha hūṃ/ ar+ghṃ puṣ+pe nas shabha 'i bar gyis mchod/ nyer gsum pa cod pan gyi dbang ni/ gzhan rnams de dang 'dra ba las/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du swā las rin po che swās mtshan pa las/ rat+na he ru ka yab yum sku mdog ser po/ rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i cod pan du 'gyur gyi bar gong bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi rgyan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa dang*/ / dar dpyangs dag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra mu ku ṭa rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa tra ཾ / gong bzhin mchod/ nyer bzhi pa rdo rje'i dbang ni/ snga ma gnyis la 'don pa bsgyur te/ a las pad+ma as mtshan pa/ pad+ma he ru ka yab yum sku mdog dmar po/ pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa= rdo rjer gyur/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ye shes byang chub sems yin te/ /gnyis med don gyi ngo bo 'dis/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ oṃ badz+ra bodhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/

mchod/ nyer lnga pa dril bu'i dbang ni/ hā las rgya gram hās mtshan pa las/ karma he ru ka yab yum sku mdog ljang khu/ /ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa= dril bur gyur/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byang chub sgom phyir rang bzhin no/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro ba/ /de ring khyod la 'dis dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ra a ti pa ti a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ nyer drug pa ming gi dbang ni/ oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ bud+dha he ru ka yab yum sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa= rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ 'di ste sangs rgyas dngos yin te/ /rab tu bsngags pa gsang ba'i ming*/ /rdo rje che ge mo zhes pas// de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa badz+ra na maḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs gsang ming 'dogs te/ spyi dang mthun pa nyid legs shing*/ rnying ma ba rang lugs kyi rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal sogs rigs lnga dang mi 'gyur lhun grub/ mi ldog yang dag /dri med grub pa rnams la rtsal gyi mtha' can du byed pa sogs kyang 'dug cing*/ me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i mtshan rtags kyang legs pa yin no/ /mchod/ de ltar na dbang lnga bskur bas/ nyon mongs lnga ye shes lngar gyur/ phung po lnga rgyal ba lnga'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa yin no/ / nyer bdun pa phyag mtshan gyi dbang ni/ bdag nyid badz+ra he ru ka rdo rje gzhon nu'i ngo bor gyur/ a las byung ba'i ban+dha hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse dgu pa'o/ /shes rab pad+ma'i snod kyi mchog /thabs mchog rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ /thabs dang shes rab phyag mtshan 'di// de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pradzña u pa ya/ sa ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ spro na cod pan dang 'di'i bar la/ brten byed kyi chu dbang re yang bskur bar 'dug go / nyer brgyad pa slob dpon gyi dbang las don tshan thog ma gsol btab ni/

maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob dpon dam pa dgongs su gsol/ /sems can kun la phan btags phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid/ /de ring bdag la lung bstan stsol/ lan gsum/ don tshan gnyis pa lhar bskyed pa ni/ dbang staigs kyi steng du rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ steng du gdugs dkar po/ mtha' skor du mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po dang bcas pa'o/ / don tshan gsum pa rdor dril gtad pa ni/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje dang*/ a las byung ba'i dril bu/ thabs mchog ye shes rdo rje dang*/ /shes rab chos kyi dril bu gzung*/ /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs/ dam tshig gsum po rab tu brtan/ don tshan bzhi pa chu dbang bskur ba ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po ru/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ don tshan lnga pa brtan bzhugs ni/ puṣ+pe la sogs pas mchod/ me tog gtor zhing rol chen dang bcas pas/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ de rnams slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*/ / nyer dgu pa rjes gnang la/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyi rjes gnang ni/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ de bzhin du rdo rje rin chen/ pad+ma/ ral gri rnams la gong bzhin sbyar dung gtad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ tshig snga ma gsum 'dra ba las/ khyod kyi chos kyi dung bus shig / bka'i gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ slob ma dam pa khyod kyis kyang*/ /ji ltar 'dul ba'i 'phrin las kyang*/ /slob dpon las rnams ci rigs par/ /de ring phan chad sgrub par gyis/ de ltar na bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ mos pa'i spyod pa'i sa sbyor ba'i lam mo/ /sum cu pa gsang dbang la maṇ+ḍal phul/

gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob dpon dam pa bde gshegs gtso/ /rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang gsum dam pa'i dbang mchog 'di/ /de ring bdag las gnang bar gsol/ gsang dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu dpa' bo gcig pa'i skur gyur/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das yab yum thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i tshogs bde ba chen po'i nyams bskyed/ thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams zhal du zhugs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ /thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag byang chub sems kyi rdo rje 'di/ /sems kyi rnam rtog mun bcom nas/ /gsang ba'i gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /de ring khyod la dbab par bya/ bdud rtsi myangs/ de ring sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /bdag ni bsod nams skal pa che/ /dpal ldan yon tan kun gyi rgyan/ /rdo rje gzhon nu bdag nyid do/ / lung bstan pa ni byed tshul spyi dang 'dra ba las/ tshig 'di skad ces/ ji ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod bton/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhur+bhu ba swa/ zhes pa'o/ /de ltar na gsang pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ don dam pa'i sems dang po bskyed pa mthong ba'i lam mo/ /so gcig pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ji ltar mkhyen pa'i thugs chud pa/ /de ltar rjes su bdag la ni/ /shes rab ye shes dbang bskur stsol/ thog mar gdams pa ni/ sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyang*/ /shes rab ma la brten pas 'grub/ /ye shes skye ba'i gzhi yin phyir/ khyod kyis 'dod chags ma sdangs shig dri ba dri lan ni/

bu khyod tshur shog rdo rje can/ / gzhi mnyam gla rtsi spyod nus sam/ /rak+ta ga bur bza' ba dang*/ /bud med dad pas bsten nus sam/ /pad+mar 'o byed mi rtog gam/ /smros shig snod ldan ngang tshul can/ lan ni/ shes rab dad pas bdag bsten to/ /bdud rtsi lnga la gus par bgyid/ /bde ba sgrub par gdab pa ni/ smad byung nga yi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba thams cad 'di las rnyed/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kun/ /rtag tu 'di dang mi 'bral te/ /pad+ma 'di ni chos dbyings yin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'di las 'byung*/ /sems can thams cad 'di ru grol/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lo la/ /pad+ma zhes byar rab tu gsungs/ /pad+ma nang gi nam mkha' zhes/ /'byung ba lnga po rang bzhin gnas/ /lte ba dang ni ge sar bcas/ /pad+ma brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /ze'u 'bru dbus nas 'byung ba yin/ /de nyid bdud rtsi dam pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po'o/ / zhes gdams pa thob/ shes rab dam pa 'di yis ni/ khyod kyi ye shes skyed byed pas/ dad pas rab tu bsten par gyis/ zhes slob dpon gyis bdag la shes rab yang dag par gtad/ tha mal gyi rtog pa spangs nas lha dang sngags dang chos kyi thabs mkhas su bsgyur nas/ rjes chags snyoms 'jug bde ba chen po la brten nas/ zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa mngon du byas/ dbugs dbyung ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ngo bo nyid du khyod gyur to/ khams gsum bdag por khyod gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyod gyur to/ /bdud dang mu stegs thams cad las/ /rgyal bar gyur ba khyod yin no/ /grong khyer las kyang grong khyer te/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i grong khyer du/ /blo ldan snod can khyod bzhugs pas/ /sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i rgyu 'di yin/ de ltar na shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ sa dgu'i bdag nyid sgom pa'i lam mo/ /so gnyis pa dbang bzhi pa las/ gsol btab ni/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis/

/ sangs rgyas kun kyi byang chub sems/ /don chen zab mos nyon mongs 'joms// de ring bdag la gnang bar zhu/ lan gsum/ rgyu'i mthar phyin pa bdud rtsi sbyin pa ni/ rang nyid he ru ka yab yum rjes su chags pa'i snyoms par zhugs pa'i/ byang chub kyi sems dbang gi gnas su phyin pa'i ye shes dper mtshon par byas/ oṃ mahā bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ byang chub kyi sems mkha'i dkyil 'khor las ro 'dzin gyi blang ste myangs pa'i nyams myong la mnyam par bzhag 'bras bu mthar phyin brjod bral sgom pa ni/ 'di ltar mtha' yas snang ba kun/ /skad cig gcig la dmigs med de/ /brjod pa'i tha snyad kun dang bral/ /rang byung ye shes zhes byar brjod/ / de ltar na bzhi pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ mthar phyin mi slob pa'i lam mo/ / so gsum pa dam tshig sgrags pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon mched lcam la/ /sgo gsum sgo nas gnod pa byed/ /sku yi dam tshig nyams par 'gyur/ /de las ldog te phan par bya/ /sngags dang snying po bar chad cing*/ /gsang ba bsrung par ma nus pa/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa yin/ / phyag rgya bzhi gsal de las bzlog /gsang bcu la sogs gnyer gtad pa/ / snod min pa la gsang ma thub/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa ste/ /de las bzlog te gsang ba bsrung*/ /sbyor sgrol ma sbyin len dang rdzun du smra/ /tshig rlangs la sogs dam tshig lnga rnams ni/ /'gro ba'i don du gzhung bzhin spyad par bgyi/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang*/ /phrag dog la sogs nyon mongs lnga rnams ni/ /ye shes ngo bo nyid kyi spang mi bya/ /dri chen dri chu dmar chen zil pa dang*/ /mdangs chen la sogs dam rdzas lnga rnams ni/ /gnyis med tshul gyis dang du blang bar bya/ /phung po lnga dang 'byung ba chen po lnga/ kha dog lnga dang yul lnga dbang po lnga/ /rnam shes lnga dang yul lnga ye shes lnga/ /yab lnga yum lnga sbyor zhing shes par bya/

/rdo rje rigs dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ /rin chen rigs dang bde bzhin pad+ma'i rigs/ /las kyi rigs te rgyal ba rigs lnga po/ /le lo spangs te ting 'dzin grub par bya/ skabs 'dir dam tshig nyi shu rtsa brgyad po de tsam zhig bstan no/ /rjes kyi bya ba ni/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs dang*/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams bya'o/ /slob ma la dbang bskur pa'i dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni/ bdag 'jug shes na 'bad med du go ba'i phyir dang*/ yi ge nyung ba la dga' ba'i phyir 'dir ma brjod do// // zhus so// bkra shis// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/slob ma la dbang bskur bar byed pa'i tshul bzhugs/ -PAGE 180--PAGE 181--PAGE 176-
